params.body:
Replaces #752, which gated on "no package at all". Same effect today, different promise.

Ilse switched the modules off for M.I. Cars, removed his vehicles and his login, and the iframe on
his site still served our catalogue from traders.stocklistdealer.eu. It answered 200.
`website/{dealer_hash}` decrypted the hash, found the dealer and rendered; it checked nothing else,
so the embed kept working for as long as a former customer left the snippet in his page.

His was empty, which is the mild version. With `website_stocklist_integration` on, the widget shows
the shared stocklist instead of the dealer's own stock, and then a former customer keeps publishing
other dealers' cars on his own website. The page answered 200 either way, so nothing reported it.

**Why module 1 and not "no package at all".** Counted on production, 22 September 2026:

| | dealers | with the widget configured |
|---|---|---|
| module 1 on | 130 | 106 |
| module 1 off, module 2 on (traders) | 305 | 0 |
| module 1 off, module 2 off | 120 | 52 |

No trader has ever configured the widget, so both conditions refuse exactly the same 52 dealers
today. Module 1 is the one written down, because the widget publishes own stock, that is what the
dealers are being told, and a condition that merely coincides with the promise stops coinciding the
day somebody gives a trader a widget.

Two other choices worth naming:

- The check is middleware on the whole route group, not a guard in the controller. There are ten
  public entry points into `WebsiteController` and the eleventh would be added without it.
- It refuses only what it is sure about. A hash that will not decrypt, or one that points at no
  dealer, is passed through exactly as before: this is a gate on a module, not a second opinion on
  everything that can be wrong with a URL. A test pins that.

The 410 page carries no branding and no logo: it renders inside somebody else's site, and putting
our mark there is worse than the empty list it replaces.

Run against the routes currently on main, the test reports the live situation: "Expected response
status code [410] but received 200."

Note for the merge: 52 dealers have the widget configured without module 1, twelve of them with the
shared stocklist on. That list has gone to Ilse.
params.title: The embed on a dealer's own site is part of module 1
